digest.component_or_area: rebar plan vocabulary and criteria routing
propositions: The split between Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria headings is vestigial; all criteria gates pool them and apply a single bar, making the distinction carry no semantic load.

Success Criteria items written as plain bullets do not count toward P1's blocking floor, cannot carry the [operator-attested] tag, and are not individually checkable, creating a tightness gap that collapse resolves.

Store tickets' ## Success Criteria headings must migrate to ## Acceptance Criteria with bullets converted to - [ ] checkboxes so criteria are counted by _count_ac_items() and carry full gate coverage.

Detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing index, author guides, generated criteria guide, eval specs, and test corpus must all transition from dual-heading vocabulary to single Acceptance Criteria vocabulary.

Four exclusions must survive the collapse: dod_uncertifiable wording in three verifier files, plan_review_T2.md's generic English about experiment metrics, O-RAN-SC consortium references, and frozen test fixtures.
ADR 0053 grandfathering of registry drift makes this rename now affordable after ticket 1f32 invalidated 632 prior attestations repo-wide.
